heroHeadline: Erdoğan Vows to Purge Markets of 'Greedy Parasites' as 85 Are Arrested in Fund Probe
heroSubtitle: Erdoğan said on Oct 7 that capital markets would be cleansed after the investment fund turmoil, as Justice Minister Gürlek reported 85 arrests. A Fund Coordination Board under VP Yılmaz is overseeing liquidation of 130+ funds holding roughly 455,000 investors' money, with interim payments of up to 1M lira per investor approved. The opposition continues to demand early elections.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets (AP, Reuters, BBC, Washington Post, Euronews, Foreign Policy, Balkan Insight, Turkish Minute, Türkiye Today), Socialist International statements, and US State Department readouts.
